text:
Comment: The South Carolina Forestry Commission indicates a concern that the proposed legislation does not provide for removal of species from the endangered list once their recovery has been achieved.
Response: Concern is unwarranted because indications of that authority are apparent in HR 4758 in Section 2(c) (2) which provides for the Secretary to review "any listed or unlisted species or subspecies of fish and wildlife proposed to be removed from, added to or reclassified within the list..."
Also, lands no longer essential to restoration of a species may be opened up to other uses by the Secretary just as other public lands are managed.
